subtitle.zh: Local FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B distilled, INT8 / BF16) on an isolated ComfyUI: text-to-image, multi-reference editing, mask inpaint, transparent background. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (8GB+ VRAM for INT8).
subtitle.en: Local FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B distilled, INT8 / BF16) on an isolated ComfyUI: text-to-image, multi-reference editing, mask inpaint, transparent background. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (8GB+ VRAM for INT8).

notes.zh: MTNode runs an isolated ComfyUI (127.0.0.1:8197) with native nodes (UNETLoader / CLIPLoader type=flux3 / ReferenceMultiLatent / SetLatentNoiseMask). The flux3klein_gen canvas node mirrors the image-generation node: prompt, multi-reference editing, ratio buckets, gacha rolls, seed and mask inpaint; transparent background is done as a two-pass difference matte by the host.
